statement: New AWS G7 instances are claimed to deliver 4.6x AI inference performance versus the previous generation, and vector indexing up to 9x faster at a quarter of the cost.
why: Falling cost per unit of useful work tends to expand the volume of work customers buy rather than shrink spending.

impact.mechanism: Better performance per dollar lowers the price of inference and retrieval workloads, encouraging larger deployments.

evidence.excerpt: vector indexing achieving 'up to 9x faster vector indexing at a quarter of the cost.'

confidence.basis: Primary source but vendor-selected benchmark claims with no stated baseline configuration.
